body:
I was open to the idea of trying to implement this, so I forked the repo and played around with it a bit. Unfortunately, this whole OSS thing is new to me, so I don't even know how to test the modified package locally.

I realize this is an edge case, so in the meantime, I can just use the `Component` mixin (or simply reset the browser's default :invalid styles) to get around the UI weirdness.

Thanks for the great package--it's much appreciated!
